messages:
Marta: heads-up — need to lock the architecture sync slot for next week. I have an RFC on model-routing policy to present. Prefer Wed 10-10:30 PT. Who can facilitate? @Ryan @Sam?

Ryan: I can facilitate that slot. Wed morning works for me. will create the invite once we confirm agenda.

Sam: Wed 10 is fine. small ask — can we keep it tight to 30m? have a deploy at 11.

Olivia: +1 to 30m. also prefer a short pre-read window (24h) so we can triage quickly.

Marta: agree on pre-read. proposed agenda (short):
```
- 10:00 roll call / objectives (2m)
- 10:02 RFC walkthrough (12m)
- 10:14 focused Q&A (10m)
- 10:24 acceptance criteria & action items (6m)
```
I'll add the RFC link in the invite.

Ryan: sounds good. I'll own facilitation. Marta — can you drop slides + a 1-paragraph summary for the pre-read?

Marta: yes — adding summary and slides here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XyZ (short link). Pre-read note: please highlight any backwards-incompatible assumptions.

Sam: volunteer to be backup facilitator if Ryan can't make it. also +1 on calling out compatibility items in the RFC.

Olivia: small process ask — can we track facilitator rotation in one place? propose a simple table in the eng-platform handbook so people can claim slots.

Ryan: good call. I'll add a facilitator column to the calendar invite and update the handbook page after the invite is out.

deploy-bot: Event created: "Architecture sync — Model-routing RFC" — Wed Jun 9 10:00 PT — Organizer: Ryan

Marta: thanks — tagging @eng-platform leads. If no objections I'll send the invite to the usual distro and mark the pre-read cutoff 24h before. :thumbsup:

Olivia: no objections. :+1:

Ryan: invite sent, included agenda and pre-read link. ping me here if you want another slide added.
